data.title: European TTF Gas Rebounds on Colder Weather, Low Storage — Market Talk
data.description: European natural-gas prices rise in early trading following the previous session's drop, with the benchmark Dutch TTF contract now up 3.7% to 83.80 euros a megawatt hour. According to ANZ analysts, the recent decline was driven by increased LNG shipments from the U.S. and weaker demand from some major Asian importers, which allowed more cargoes to be redirected toward European markets. However, weather forecasts point to colder temperatures ahead, potentially boosting heating demand and increasing pressure on supplies. Meanwhile, European gas storage levels remain relatively low, standing at 69.9% full, compared with approximately 81.9% last year, leaving the region more vulnerable to increased demand during the winter months. (giulia.petroni@wsj.com)

data.title: EDAN Presents Integrated Medical Innovations at MEDICA 2026, Strengthening Global Healthcare Connections
data.description:
Edan Instruments, Inc. (300206. SZ), a global provider of medical devices and healthcare solutions, is presenting its latest innovations at MEDICA 2026, taking place November 16–19 in Düsseldorf. The event provides an important platform for industry exchange and an opportunity for EDAN to engage with European partners on evolving healthcare needs.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261118813326/en/

“Germany and Europe are important partners in the global healthcare industry. As China’s medical technology sector expands internationally, closer collaboration with European healthcare professionals and industry partners can create opportunities for shared progress,” said Alex You, Senior Director of Marketing, Customer Service, Global Connectivity & Integration at EDAN. “By understanding local clinical needs and translating them into accessible, reliable solutions, we can contribute to more effective healthcare. MEDICA offers a valuable opportunity to strengthen these connections and exchange perspectives.”

Making its debut, the Acclarix LX9S is powered by the SynSight zone sonography platform, delivering consistent image clarity across diverse clinical scenarios. It features a new eSRI imaging algorithm, alongside a 23.8-inch display, optical trackball, and redesigned touchscreen interface. These upgrades enhance imaging performance, streamline workflows, and support confident diagnostic decision-making.

In Patient Monitoring, EDAN highlighted the iV100, which functions both as a transport monitor and as a multi-parameter module within the iV Series. With real-time PresCCO continuous cardiac output, advanced parameters, and clinical assistive applications, the iV Series supports precise and efficient critical care across varied clinical environments.

In cardiology, Smart ECG Web connects ECG devices across departments and healthcare facilities through a centralized platform for ECG data management, review, and reporting, supporting more connected clinical workflows. EDAN is also preparing to introduce a wearable Patch Holter for up to 14 days of continuous ECG recording, helping capture intermittent cardiac events that may not be detected during routine examinations.

EDAN’s OBGYN portfolio covers fetal and maternal monitoring, intrapartum imaging, endoscopy, colposcopy, and pelvic floor rehabilitation, supporting care across a range of obstetric and gynecologic settings.

In IVD, EDAN i500 blood gas and chemistry analyzer combines full benchtop capabilities with a compact design. Its latest upgrade features a co-oximetry panel and auto-QC functionality, making it well suited to critical-care settings. The H90 Series 6-part auto hematology analyzer, featuring RET detection, further expands EDAN’s testing capabilities.

In animal health, the CC30 Vet biochemistry analysis system focuses on assessing liver and kidney function in pets, with a range of cartridges and testing parameters to support different screening needs in veterinary practice.

Across its diverse medical portfolios, EDAN continues to turn clinical insights into practical solutions, with a focus on addressing real healthcare needs and improving the human condition.

For more information, please visit www.edan.com.

data.title: Uniswap to Be Integrated With Elysium
data.description:
Uniswap will add Elysium support to its wallet in November. The rollout will extend support beyond the Uniswap Web App and API, where the chain is already available for swaps and liquidity provision.

Refer to the official tweet by UNI:

Uniswap
@Uniswap

Elysium is now live on Uniswap Web App and API, with Wallet support rolling out soon

Swap, provide liquidity, and explore the chain built to scale Hyperliquid pic.twitter.com/l6R0PuNka6

Nov 18, 2026

UNI Info

Uniswap is a decentralized trading protocol known for its role in facilitating automated cryptocurrency exchanges. The protocol operates on the Ethereum network.

The Uniswap protocol consists of a set of smart contracts that enable direct trading interactions between users on the Ethereum blockchain. Technically, Uniswap is a decentralized exchange (DEX) that allows participants to buy and sell cryptocurrencies directly without the need for a centralized intermediary.

The Uniswap protocol utilizes automated market maker, which means that users can trade their assets directly with the financial reserves stored in the contracts. This differs from traditional exchanges where trades go through an order book and require centralized servers to execute transactions.

This approach enables Uniswap participants to trade cryptocurrencies in real-time, provides a high degree of transparency, and eliminates the need to trust a centralized party. Each operation on Uniswap is recorded on the Ethereum blockchain, ensuring the immutability and integrity of trading data.

Uniswap is governed through its native governance token, UNI. UNI token holders have voting rights in protocol governance matters, further enhancing its decentralized nature.

RENDER Info

Render Token, also known as RNDR, is a project aiming to democratize the process of rendering 3D content. Built on the Ethereum blockchain, the platform enables anyone in the world to use their computational resources to assist in rendering processes and be rewarded for their work in the form of RNDR tokens.

Typically, rendering 3D content can be a highly resource-intensive process, requiring significant processor time and energy. For many individuals and organizations, especially those working in industries where 3D rendering is important (like gaming, film, virtual and augmented reality), this can pose a significant challenge.

The Render Token platform addresses this issue by providing a path to a decentralized rendering network, where anyone with suitable hardware can participate. Users can “rent out” their computational resources to assist in rendering 3D content, and be rewarded for it in RNDR tokens. This creates a more democratized and efficient system, which can enhance the accessibility and speed of 3D content rendering.

Moreover, Render Token is working on innovating new uses of blockchain in the realm of digital art and graphics, including the creation and distribution of NFTs (non-fungible tokens) and other forms of digital content.

data.title: Fashion retailer Adolfo Domínguez swings to half-year loss as premium strategy hits sales
data.description:
Spanish fashion retailer Adolfo Domínguez said on Thursday its half-year net result swung to a loss, as a commercial strategy shift towards a more premium business model led to lower sales.

The decline reflects the first effects of the strategy unveiled in May, under which CEO Adriana Domínguez is repositioning the brand further upmarket, reducing discounts and prioritising profitability over volume growth.

  • First-half revenue fell 11.4% to €57.6 million ($63.2 million) due to reduced promotions and the closure of outlet stores

  • "We were aware that the change in strategy could lead to a fall in sales, particularly in Spain, which is our most mature market, but it is working in Mexico and the rest of Latin America," Domínguez said in a statement

  • "The transformation is a response to the need to reverse the stagnation in profitability and move towards a distinctly premium business model, upon which to build a more robust company," she added

  • The retailer said the first half of each financial year tended to be lower due to high seasonality in the fashion sector

  • However, adjusted EBITDA rose slightly from a year ago to €8.4 million

($1 = 0.9121 euros)

data.title: Hong Kong stocks hit 4-month low, as US-China tensions weigh on tech
data.description:
Hong Kong's share benchmark sank 2% to hit four-month lows while China stocks remained under pressure, as fresh trade tensions flared up between the US and China despite meetings between Presidents Xi Jinping and Donald Trump in Shenzhen.

** Risk appetite was also pressured by the prospect of further US rate hikes that could tighten global liquidity.

** Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index dropped 2%, plumbing to its lowest level since late June. The Hang Seng Tech Index hit a 26-month low as it extended its losing streak to seven sessions.

** In China, the blue-chip CSI300 Index finished flat and the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.3%, hitting the lowest in more than 15 months.

** Xi said on Thursday he remained committed to working with Trump to steer ties between their countries on the "correct course", even as China's commerce ministry voiced strong opposition to a recent series of economic and trade restrictions the US imposed against China.

** The Nvidia saga has led to tighter scrutiny of US chip exports to China.

** The Trump administration is also considering requiring US companies to publicly disclose their use of Chinese AI models to discourage reliance on the technology.

** Meanwhile, a US House panel asked Microsoft on Wednesday to brief lawmakers on a report that said the company could allow the Chinese firm ByteDance to use OpenAI models through Microsoft's Azure cloud platform.

** These developments deepened investor worry that the world's two largest economies are careening toward a fresh tit-for-tat trade war, after the Republicans' defeat in the US midterms appears to have prompted the White House to take a more hawkish policy toward China.

** Hong Kong-listed AI model developers and AI hyperscalers, whose competitiveness depends on advanced computing power, tumbled on Thursday.

** MiniMax slumped as much as 11% to record lows while Z.AI lost 2%.

** Tencent tumbled nearly 7% to a 31-month low after its third-quarter revenue missed forecasts, and the company said new US chip curbs may slow model training.

** Alibaba tanked 5.5% to a 22-month low, while Shanghai Iluvatar CoreX Semiconductor slumped 17%.

** In China, tech stocks that rely on advanced chips, including cloud computing (.CSI931469), AI and big data , led the declines.

data.title: LT Foods acquires Maya Kaimal for $5.8 million to deepen U.S. presence
data.description:
LT Foods Limited announced on November 19, 2026, that its U.S. subsidiary, LT Foods Americas Inc., has signed an agreement to acquire 100 per cent stake in MK Foods Holdings Inc., the parent company of Maya Kaimal Foods LLC, for an enterprise value of USD 5.8 million on a cash-free, debt-free basis. The deal is expected to close within three months, subject to standard closing conditions.

Maya Kaimal Foods offers a portfolio of premium Indian-inspired shelf-stable sauces, ready-to-eat curries and rice products. The brand reported revenue of USD 17.9 million for the twelve months ended September 30, 2026, up from USD 15.5 million in the prior year — a growth of roughly 15.5 per cent.

Acquisition to expand US ready-to-eat portfolio

The acquisition is aimed at expanding LT Foods’ Ready-to-Eat, Ready-to-Cook and Ready-to-Heat portfolio in the United States, which the company has identified as a strategically important growth market. The company said Maya Kaimal’s product development capabilities in sauces and convenient meal solutions are complementary to its existing business, and the deal is expected to open new distribution and cross-category growth opportunities.

Managing Director and CEO Ashwani Arora said the combined businesses would leverage LT Foods’ scale and market reach alongside Maya Kaimal’s consumer brand and innovation capabilities to build a sustainable growth platform in the U.S. market.

Ernst & Young served as the exclusive transaction advisor for LT Foods on the deal.

LT Foods’ financials and stock performance

LT Foods, listed on both the NSE and BSE, reported consolidated revenue of approximately ₹11,023 crore for FY26. The company’s existing U.S. portfolio is anchored by Royal, one of North America’s leading rice brands. Its stock traded at ₹439.85 on the NSE on the day of the announcement, up 4.91 per cent from the previous close of ₹419.25, touching an intraday high of ₹461.35. The stock has delivered returns of over 547 per cent over the past five years against the Nifty 500’s 55.39 per cent over the same period.

data.title: Aurionpro wins ₹100 crore data centre order, crosses ₹400 crore mark with Hyperscaler
data.description:
Aurionpro Solutions has secured an additional order worth nearly ₹100 crore from a global hyperscaler for an AI-ready data centre project in Southern India, the company announced on November 19, 2026.

The latest contract pushes the total value of engagements with this customer past ₹400 crore.

The project is scheduled for execution over nine months and represents an expansion of an existing engagement with the same hyperscaler announced earlier this year.

Bhaskar Bhattacharya, EVP and Head of Enterprise Business at Aurionpro, said the company is investing in advanced manufacturing as part of a backward integration strategy to gain greater supply chain control and improve operational efficiency for hyperscale clients.

Aurionpro shares were trading at ₹556.25 on the NSE at the time of the announcement, up marginally by 0.07 per cent.

The stock has had a difficult year, down over 47 per cent year-to-date and approximately 51 per cent over the past twelve months, against a broadly flat Nifty Total Market.

The company’s total market capitalisation stands at around ₹3,074 crore.

Aurionpro Solutions operates across banking, payments, mobility, data centres, and government sectors. The company employs over 3,000 people globally.

The growing data centre order book is emerging as a key area of traction even as the broader stock has faced significant selling pressure over the past year.
